scenes.title: Trier Social Stress Test Speech Gauntlet: Chrome Floor Mic Before Two White-Coated Judges & Tripod Camera
scenes.era: 2014 & 2017, University of Michigan & Michigan State Emotion & Self-Control Laboratories

layout.description: Crisp high-key clinical evaluation room with a brushed-chrome floor microphone at left-center facing an oak evaluator table where two motionless clothed 2.5D matte cream-white vinyl judges in crisp white lab coats sit beside a black cinema camera on an aluminum tripod.

positions.who: Adult speech participant (clothed 2.5D matte cream-white vinyl adult with smooth earless noseless hairless oval head and expressive 2D charcoal-black ink eyes, brows, and mouth in navy-blue knit crew sweater and tailored gray slacks)
positions.where: standing behind the brushed-chrome floor microphone facing the oak evaluator table
positions.facing: facing the two white-coated judges and tripod camera

positions.who: Two evaluative judges (clothed 2.5D matte cream-white vinyl adults in crisp buttoned white lab coats over dark collars)
positions.where: seated side-by-side behind the oak table flanking the black tripod camera with unmarked wooden clipboards
positions.facing: facing the standing speaker in stone-faced stillness

props.name: brushed-chrome floor microphone stand and black cinema camera on aluminum tripod
props.period_detail: authentic Kirschbaum (1993) & Kross (2014) Trier Social Stress Test speech apparatus with zero text
props.physical_behavior: State-A: speaker grips the chrome microphone stem tightly with tense raised shoulders -> State-B: releases tense two-handed grip into calm open-palmed gesture after silent first-name shift

props.name: two unmarked wooden clipboards resting on the oak judge table
props.period_detail: clean blank paper sheets held by motionless white-coated evaluators
props.physical_behavior: State-A: judges sit motionless with pens poised -> State-B: incline heads slightly marking strong confident delivery scores

actions.verb_sequence: grips the chrome microphone stem tightly with tense shoulders -> inhales calmly shifting inner voice to first name -> releases grip into steady open-palmed speech delivery

reactions.reaction: 2D charcoal-black ink brows settle from wide alarm into composed steady confidence
incline their smooth heads slightly marking confident speech ratings on blank clipboards

scenes.wardrobe: 45-year-old speaker in navy-blue knit sweater and tailored gray trousers; two evaluators in crisp white lab coats.
scenes.recognition_hook: Two minutes to prep in front of stone-faced judges and a camera — where swapping one silent word inside your head steadies your voice in one second!

key_visual.description: an adult speaker in a navy-blue sweater standing calmly with open hands at a chrome floor microphone facing two white-coated judges seated behind an oak table beside a black tripod camera

scenes.title: 2017 Michigan State ERP & fMRI Booth: 1-Second Voltage Drop With Zero Willpower Strain
scenes.era: 2017, Michigan State University ERP & University of Michigan fMRI Suites (Moser & Kross)

layout.description: Bright neurophysiology booth where the adult volunteer wearing a sleek white scalp electrode cap sits calmly beside an unmarked glass waveform monitor.

positions.who: Adult volunteer in navy sweater and white scalp sensor cap
positions.where: seated in ergonomic clinical chair with hands resting loosely on thighs

props.name: white high-density scalp sensor cap and unmarked waveform screen
props.period_detail: text-free voltage trace dropping from tall crimson peak to calm cyan-blue baseline inside 1,000 ms
props.physical_behavior: State-A: tall jagged crimson peak on screen -> State-B: drops smoothly within 1 second while volunteer's hands stay completely relaxed

actions.verb_sequence: watches tall jagged wave appear on screen -> relaxes shoulders effortlessly as the trace drops flat in one second

reactions.reaction: unstrained calm ink expression showing zero willpower effort

scenes.wardrobe: Navy-blue knit sweater and gray slacks.
scenes.recognition_hook: Emotional brainwave voltage drops inside 1,000 milliseconds without burning a drop of prefrontal willpower.

scenes.title: Sunlit Brick Courtyard Walk Before the Big Meeting: Coaching Yourself Like a Friend (Outdoor)
scenes.era: Modern sunlit outdoor brick university / corporate plaza

layout.description: Open-world sunlit outdoor brick courtyard framed by autumn trees outside glass office doors where the 45-year-old adult in a navy blazer pauses, closes a leather portfolio calmly, and steps forward.

positions.who: 45-year-old professional in navy blazer over white shirt
positions.where: standing on the sunlit brick plaza outside glass building doors
positions.facing: forward toward the entrance with composed posture

props.name: unmarked tan leather briefing portfolio in sunlit plaza
props.period_detail: everyday pre-presentation moment for midlife professionals
props.physical_behavior: State-A: pauses holding open folder -> State-B: closes portfolio crisply under arm and strides smoothly toward glass doors

actions.verb_sequence: pauses on sunlit brick plaza -> closes leather portfolio crisply under left arm and strides forward calmly

reactions.reaction: steady confident ink expression ready for high-stakes talk

scenes.wardrobe: Tailored navy blazer, crisp white shirt, gray slacks.
scenes.recognition_hook: Silently calling yourself by your own first name turns you into the calm advisor you already are for your friends.
